data.name: Car Organizer Bag
data.description:
EZI STORAGE is an easily transportable car storage bag.

Place it in the back of your car, next to your child, in the front or in the trunk and enjoy perfect organization in your car. It allows you to easily have everything your child needs at your disposal, diapers, wipes, bottle of water etc...

No more objects lying around during the road! It became Ezi to park his car.

Easy to transport, take it everywhere with you, once empty, the organizer folds and stores easily thanks to its compact size.

EZI STORAGE is made from 70% recycled plastic.

  • Multi-compartments

  • Foldable

  • Large storage capacity

  • Has multiple compartments

  • Easy to carry

  • Folds compactly

  • Foldable

  • Dimensions: 32 x 26 x 18cm

data.description:

data.name: Storage Basket / Diaper Caddy Organizer
data.description:
The diaper caddy organizer stands as the epitome of convenience for baby supplies. Its ingenious design showcases multiple pockets and customizable partitions that adapt to your unique needs. Effortlessly move it from room to room or even to your car using the convenient handles, making parenting easier wherever you are.

Key Features:

  • Thoughtfully designed using premium quality felt and soft PU vegan leather

  • Featherlight at just 0.3 kg, ensuring effortless portability

  • Durable construction that requires minimal care

  • Spacious interior boasting up to 11 versatile pockets, providing a dedicated place for every essential

  • Two removable partitions to transform the interior based on your specific requirements

Designed and developed in Estonia, the diaper caddy organizer epitomizes functional elegance. Experience the perfect blend of style and purpose, and take a step towards a more organized and stress-free parenting journey.

data.name: Premium Car Seat Protector
data.description:
The EZI MAT PREMIUM car seat protector mat by Ezimoov is the ideal solution for parents who want to protect their car seats from dirt, spills and scratches. This premium protective cover fits most car seats and is easy to install thanks to its adjustable and sturdy straps.

The protector is equipped with three large mesh storage pockets, providing ample space to store your child’s toys, snacks, and other accessories. It ensures that your child has everything they need within easy reach while keeping your vehicle organized and clutter-free. 

Not only does the Ezi Mat Premium help keep your car tidy, but it also prevents wear and tear on your seats. Its large size covers the full front of your back car seat, safeguarding it against scratches, stains, and shoe marks. Made from easy-to-clean materials, it offers practicality and convenience for busy parents on the go.

The EZI TRAVEL PLUS is made of 62% recycled plastic. The seat organizer is designed to last over time and withstand any test.

  • 3 large mesh pockets for storing toys and accessories

  • Protects car seats from scratches, dirt and spills

  • Keeps your car organized

  • Easy installation with adjustable and sturdy straps

  • Fits most car seats

  • Easy to clean and maintain

  • Dimensions: 118 x 75.5 cm

data.name: Ezi Mat 3 in 1 Seat Protector
data.description:
EZI MAT 3 IN 1 is a rear seat organizer, a front seat back protector and also a rear seat protector.

In seat organizer mode: organize and store everything your child needs during the trip. Your little one will have everything they need right at their fingertips.

In front seat back protection mode: protect the front seat from your child's shoe prints and any other dirt that could make the seat dirty.

In rear seat protection mode: protect your child's rear seat from possible stains and wear. Easy to install, its adjustable straps attach to any headrest and fit most cars.

EZI MAT 3 IN 1 is made from 72% recycled plastic.

  • 3 uses: back seat organizer, seat cushion and backrest protector.

  • Organizer for low back, high back and back seat.

  • Easy to clean

  • Easy installation

  • Adjustable straps

  • Black color

  • Material: RPET polyester

  • Dimensions: 123 x 48.5cm

data.name: Wooden Wall Decoration - Retro Car
data.description:
A cool decoration for car enthusiasts! The fastest four wheels for the youngest!

The Retro Car - Formula One, Wall Plywood Decoration is a unique retro-style wall decoration that will delight every Formula One racing fan. Perfect for children's rooms, it adds a dynamic character to the interior and brings a smile to every child's face.

Assembling this decoration is real fun, resembling putting together large wooden puzzles. Thanks to the rubber mounting bands included in the set, the decoration can be easily moved to different parts of the room. The decoration is double-sided, allowing for creative placement on the wall. The package also includes instructions and a detailed description of the assembly.

  • Material: Made from 3mm birch plywood. Carefully sanded on both sides for a smooth and safe surface. Unique plywood color variations make each car one of a kind.

  • Design: Retro style inspired by Formula One. Can be mounted in a mirror image. Fun and engaging assembly process, similar to putting together puzzles.

  • Easy to assemble with included rubber mounting bands. Can be moved without leaving marks on the wall. Perfect for children's rooms, suitable for both boys and girls. Specifications:

  • Size S: 105 cm wide, 57 cm high.

  • Size M: 125 cm wide, 68 cm high.

  • Material: 3mm birch plywood. Additional Information:

  • Perfect Gift: An excellent decoration for any speed and car enthusiast, adding a unique character to any child's room. Easy

  • Installation: The set includes rubber mounting bands and instructions, making it easy to install and reposition the decoration.

  • Handcrafted Quality: Each piece is carefully made to ensure the highest quality and durability.

data.description:

data.name: Decorative Basket Tractor
data.description:
The handmade, cotton decorative basket Tractor from the Farm collection is a unique and fun element that will introduce a rustic, country atmosphere to your interior. The basket consists of two parts in an intense shade of green, reminiscent of a classic tractor. Additional details, such as small lights, 8 round pompoms imitating tractor tires and a license plate with the inscription L0 R3 NA, give it character and make it a real decoration of any room. The Tractor basket is an excellent choice for storing toys, small items or accessories, combining functionality with original design. Ideal for a child's room or a space in the country style, it will certainly attract attention and add joy to any interior.

  • Dimensions: 35 x 15 x 15 cm

  • Color: Green

  • Composition: 97% cotton, 3% other fibers

  • Weight: 1.11 kg

  • Certificates: ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 14001

Care: Do not wash in a washing machine. Avoid prolonged exposure to the sun. To remove stains, use lukewarm water and mild soap.

data.name: Rain Protection for baby Car Seat
data.description:
Protect your baby from the elements with the Ezi Rain Protect Cosy, a waterproof and breathable rain cover designed specifically for cosy car seats and Group 0 infant carriers.

This rain cover provides breathable protection against rain and wind, ensuring your child stays dry while allowing for optimal airflow for their comfort. Lightweight and easy to install, it fits most cosy car seats and Group 0 infant carriers, offering full coverage during bad weather.

Conveniently, the Ezi Rain Protect Cosy also features an integrated storage pouch, making it easy to store when not in use.

Made with 60% recycled plastic, this product is eco-friendly while providing an efficient and durable solution to protect your baby during your travels.

Features:

  • Waterproof and breathable protection: Effectively shields against rain and wind.

  • Fits cosy car seats / Group 0 infant carriers: Designed for easy installation and perfect coverage.

  • Integrated storage pouch: Convenient for easy storage when not in use.

  • Made with 60% recycled plastic

data.name: Wooden Construction Cars with Animals
data.description:
A builder is only as good as their tools, so equip your little construction enthusiast with these two beautiful wooden trucks. Baby will love the satisfying rattle of the mixer’s tank and the tipping motion of the dump truck, with Mr. Dino and Mr. Tiger as their hard-working assistants. These cheerfully coloured characters fit in both trucks, so they can mix and match.

Details:

  • Material: FSC® MDF - FSC® beech wood - FSC® plywood

  • Age recommendation: 18m+

  • Dimensions: 10.5x7.5x7 cm

data.name: Origami Nursery Mobile - Gold Dust
data.description:
Everything really does revolve around the baby. This handmade nursery mobile is a soft, elegant decoration you can hang above a crib or in any cozy corner of the room. The gentle movement of the paper cranes and pompoms helps catch your baby’s eye, encouraging visual focus, calmness, and a bit of fun.

Made with thick, acid-free paper, natural wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, and tiny bells—it's part toy, part art. A breeze or a small touch sets it in motion, creating a peaceful atmosphere. It’s also a lovely piece to hang in a toddler's or even older child’s room, or a thoughtful gift for a new family.

  • Materials: acid-free paper, wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, bells

  • Handmade with care

  • Length: approx. 55 cm

  • Subtle, Scandinavian-inspired design

  • Works beautifully on its own or paired with garlands or wall hangings

  • Made in Poland

Originally designed as a personal project, the mobile has become a signature Moi Mili item. Let it spin.

Note: All Moi Mili products are handmade in small batches. Occasionally, a product may show as in stock but has just sold out — in that case, please allow 2–22 working days for production.

data.name: Leash – Travel
data.description:
The travel collection is a bull's-eye for all travel lovers. A colorful pattern depicting a plane crossing the most popular places around the world will catch the eye of every globetrotter. Products of the travel collection include, among others, the Eiffel Tower, the Statue of Liberty, the Egyptian Pyramids, the Warsaw's Mermaid, the Sagrada Familia and others!

data.name: Rear Facing Car Seat Mirror
data.description:
EZI MIRROR CLASSIC is a large mirror to place on the back seat of your car.

Slightly curved, it gives you a full view of your child without having to turn around, just look from your front mirror.

Monitor your little one's well-being from the comfort of your driving seat. Easy to install , the EZI MIRROR CLASSIC features cross straps that allow the mirror to be attached to any rear seat headrest of any vehicle in seconds.

The EZI MIRROR CLASSIC is made from 92% recycled plastic. Durable, this car mirror will give you many years of daily use.

  • Fits all headrests

  • Easy to assemble

  • Acrylic mirror

  • Ideal for monitoring your child

  • Mirror

data.name: Wooden Car - Retro
data.description:
The Wooden Story Car is a charming toy that will take your child on a journey full of adventures, inspiring creative play and imagination. Its design brings to mind rides on sandy roads or chestnut alleys, combining aesthetics, education and ecological production. Thanks to its moving wheels, the car provides the child with engaging play, developing fine motor skills and creativity, while introducing the toddler to the world of natural materials.

Product features:

• Smooth and pleasant to the touch surface

• Stimulates imagination

• Supports the development of creativity

• Supports sensory and manual development

Eco-friendly product:

• Made of wood from FSC certified suppliers

• Natural colors of various types of wood

• Finished with beeswax and vegetable oils, making it exceptionally smooth and pleasant to the touch

• The cardboard packaging is recyclable

• Free from harmful substances

Recommended age: 2 years+

Dimensions:

• Dimensions without packaging: 11 x 6 x 5 cm

• Dimensions with packaging: 14.5 x 10.5 x 5.5 cm

• Weight: 0.15 kg

data.description:

The LED light is comforting during night drives, but dim enough not to dazzle the eyes of your little one. Turn it on easily from the remote. The mirror is eco-friendly and made from quality materials, providing many years of daily use. Ezimoov products use recycled bottles for material and the packaging is made of recycled cardboard with a minimal amount of plastic.

The EZI MIRROR LED mirror is made from 82% recycled plastic.

  • Fits all headrests

  • Easy assembly

  • Acrylic mirror

  • LED night light

  • rotating base

  • Ideal for monitoring your child

  • Remote control included

data.name: Marone Wicker Bike Basket With Beige Lining And Straps
data.description:

Hand-woven from natural, eco-friendly willow, it exemplifies European quality and attention to detail. Made in Poland, it delights with solid craftsmanship and a timeless design that suits both modern and classic bikes. EZI MAT 3 IN 1 is a rear seat organizer, a front seat back protector and also a rear seat protector.

In seat organizer mode: organize and store everything your child needs during the trip. Your little one will have everything they need right at their fingertips.

In front seat back protection mode: protect the front seat from your child's shoe prints and any other dirt that could make the seat dirty.

In rear seat protection mode: protect your child's rear seat from possible stains and wear. Easy to install, its adjustable straps attach to any headrest and fit most cars.

EZI MAT 3 IN 1 is made from 72% recycled plastic.

  • 3 uses: back seat organizer, seat cushion and backrest protector.

  • Organizer for low back, high back and back seat.

  • Easy to clean

  • Easy installation

  • Adjustable straps

  • Black color

  • Material: RPET polyester

  • Dimensions: 123 x 48.5cm

data.name: Kids Mealtime Floor Mat, Non-Slip & Waterproof - Red Frame
data.description:
A practical floor mat that looks good in your home. Protects your floors from food, spills, and creative messes. Made from soft, durable vegan leather with a non-slip bottom so it stays in place during mealtime chaos or craft time experiments.

It keeps the area under the high chair clean and saves your floor from daily food chaos. The surface is easy to wipe and fully waterproof, so spills don’t soak in. The non-slip bottom keeps the mat in place and protects the floor from chair movement. It’s flexible, so you can roll or fold it away when not in use, and it works just as well indoors as it does outside.

  • Size: 125x95 cm

  • Material: High-quality vegan leather

  • Non-toxic and child-safe

  • Waterproof and wipeable

  • For floors, tables, picnic setups, craft corners, and more

  • Made in Europe

Cleaning and care

  • Wipe clean or rinse under running water

  • Machine washable at 30°C

  • Avoid harsh or alcohol-based cleaners

  • Not cut-proof

  • Permanent markers may leave stains

  • If creases appear, steam iron through a cloth (never directly on the leather)

Color may vary slightly depending on lighting.

data.name: Check Classic Wallpaper - Beige
data.description:
Beige check pattern, probably the most universal of all colors. It warms up the interior. It is a "safe" pattern, we can apply two or even four walls with such a light pattern. There is no strong contrast here, no dark colors.

We highly recommend it for darker rooms without perfect access to day light.

  • Material: Refined, durable, matte paper (non-adhesive)

  • Fire safety: Certified non-flammable (EU standards)

  • Made in the EU

  • Glue required: Use regular wallpaper glue that is not solvent-based (Flugger 377 is recommended)


This wallpaper is sold in stripes, each:

  • Height: 280 cm

  • Width: 50 cm

To order the correct amount:

  1. Measure the width of your wall.

  2. Divide that by 50 cm (each stripe's width).

  3. Round up to the next whole number – that’s how many stripes you’ll need.

Each stripe includes extra height to fit standard walls, so you can trim as needed. The repeating pattern means it’s easy to match stripes without stress. Just start from the ceiling and you’re good. Before you apply wallpaper and any wall – please thoroughly prime the wall and clean the surface of dust or grease. The wallpaper can be applied on the walls only after about 20 days from the last painting.

data.name: MeowBaby® Plywood Kitchen Helper Scandi - White
data.description:
MeowBaby® Kitchen Helper Scandi will enable your child safely and easily reach the kitchen counter. The three-stage height adjustment means that this piece of furniture may stay in your kitchen for many years. The highest platform can be used by toddlers who have just learned how stand on their own, while the lowest level is suitable for older children until they grow out of it.

The kitchen helper guarantees mutual joy in everyday activities. Now you don’t need to move a chair to the counter or sit your child on the table anymore! Make sure that your child is safe while cooking together and strengthen their sense of independence.

This stable kitchen helper is made of a moisture-resistant and abrasion-resistant birch plywood covered on both sides with a melamine coating.

The simplicity of white smooth sides and visible wooden edges remind you of Scandinavian minimalism.

Information:

  • Material: birch plywood: sides covered with melamine, oiled edges

  • Adjustable platform (20 cm – 30 cm – 40 cm, measured from the floor level), in order to adjust the height of the platform to the height of your child, you only need to put the platform onto the chosen level

  •  Dimensions:

    • overall height: 90 cm

    • width: 39 cm

    • depth to the step: 52 cm

    • thickness of the plate: 1.6 cm

  • Made in Poland

data.name: Origami Nursery Mobile - Gold Dust
data.description:
Everything really does revolve around the baby. This handmade nursery mobile is a soft, elegant decoration you can hang above a crib or in any cozy corner of the room. The gentle movement of the paper cranes and pompoms helps catch your baby’s eye, encouraging visual focus, calmness, and a bit of fun.

Made with thick, acid-free paper, natural wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, and tiny bells—it's part toy, part art. A breeze or a small touch sets it in motion, creating a peaceful atmosphere. It’s also a lovely piece to hang in a toddler's or even older child’s room, or a thoughtful gift for a new family.

  • Materials: acid-free paper, wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, bells

  • Handmade with care

  • Length: approx. 55 cm

  • Subtle, Scandinavian-inspired design

  • Works beautifully on its own or paired with garlands or wall hangings

  • Made in Poland

Originally designed as a personal project, the mobile has become a signature Moi Mili item. Let it spin.

Note: All Moi Mili products are handmade in small batches. Occasionally, a product may show as in stock but has just sold out — in that case, please allow 2–22 working days for production.

data.name: Interior & Sanitary Protector EcoCare, 500ml
data.description:
GoGoNano EcoCare sanitary protector is designed for interior and bathroom surfaces. The nano coating enhances hygiene and reduces dirt adhesion on various surfaces, including glossy, matte, and non-slip materials. EcoCare bathroom protector is suitable for smooth, rough, natural, and plastic surfaces in sanitary areas.

  • Ecofriendly and natural ingredients.

  • Completely safe for the environment, health and materials.

  • Ensures long-term hygiene and a clean appearance on all interior and sanitary surfaces.

  • Easy to use and immediate results.

  • Suitable for most materials: smooth, rough, natural and plastic surfaces.

EcoCare is incredibly simple to use. To achieve the best results, we recommend shaking the bottle and cleaning the surfaces with EcoClean stain remover before using the protector. To achieve the best results, the protective agent should only be used on previously cleaned or clean surfaces. Then, using a soft microfiber cloth, apply the product directly to the surface. Allow the protective agent to work for about 10-15 minutes. After that, use a microfiber cloth or household paper to remove the residue from the treated surface.

The product is meant to be used on a regular basis. There is no reason to repeat the process before three months have passed.

Correct dosing of the protective agent is also important. If you use too little EcoCare bathroom protector, it may not do its job well enough. However, too much can cause unwanted drips and residue. You will achieve good efficiency if you use about 10 ml / m2.

Use EcoCare nano interior & sanitary protection agent:

  • In the bathroom, on the sink, wall tiles, floor tiles, water closet

  • In the kitchen, on work surfaces, sinks, floor and wall tiles

  • On the dining table, sofa table, children’s desk

  • In the hall closet, on the shelves

  • On doors, as well as around handles or knobs

  • On all other hard surfaces except glass surfaces that are frequently used or dirty.

Safety: Not a hazard product. Keep out of reach of children. Consumption: About 10 ml / m2.

data.name: Stay Dry Nano Coating Spray for Textile & Leather – Waterproof and Stain Resistant Protection
data.description:
Stay Dry protective nano coating spray creates an ultra-thin, durable protective layer on textile and leather. This nano coating bonds with the surface and provides superior water and stain resistance for up to 18 months.

Invisible and breathable Stay Dry textile protection has the following properties:

  • Instant and long-lasting protection for up to 18 months

  • Superhydrophobic – adds durable water repellent properties. Water and dirt simply roll off.

  • Oil repellent / Stain repellent

  • Restores to like-new performance

  • Completely invisible and doesn’t alter the look or feel of the material

  • UV-protection prevents fading from sun exposure

  • Effective without heat activation

Stay Dry superhydrophobic textile and leather nano coating spray is a biosolvent based formula and is created specifically for the protection of all textile, leather, and suede articles including but not limited to clothes, shoes, bags, sportswear, and outdoor equipment.

It forms an invisible protective coating on the material up to the level of the individual fiber preventing the infiltration of liquids, such as red wine, into the fibers and as such inhibiting the formation of stubborn stains. Fluids entering in contact with the treated article are easily removed with a moist cloth and will not cause any damage to the article. The protection of the treated material lasts for 6 months up to 2 years.

In the past many solvents have garnered a negative reputation for being environmentally harmful or toxic. Stay Dry textile protection, however, utilizes alkane isoparaffins, a mixture of hydrocarbons (mineral oils), as the formula’s solvent base. This maintains the formula’s eco-friendly status.

Stay Dry Textile and Leather formula is highly sensitive to laundry and other detergents. We recommend washing items treated with this formula only with warm water without detergents or very soft detergents.

How to use nano coating spray:

1. Clean the substrate when polluted.
2. Shake bottle well before using it.
3. Spray evenly on the surface, approx. from a 10 cm for textile and 30 cm distance from leather.

Properties: After the evaporation of the solvent a Fluor polymer modiﬁed nanolayer is formed. This layer of a thickness of a between 100 nanometres to microns (1/1000 mm) is water and oil repellent. The complete drying process and effectiveness of the impregnation will take in approx. 24 hours at RH of max 70%. After staining the substrate with water or oily like products, the stain has to be absorbed with absorbing paper.

Do not wipe the stain away. Oily stains can form a shadow or ring. This can be removed or strongly reduced by cleaning with a detergent. The uniform coated layer does not affect the appearance of the textile or leather. Some substrates may become slightly darker in color. This is depending on the amount and thickness of the coating layer.

Textile protection properties: The product has been tested to be active after application for 18 months, however, if items are frequently used or by wear and environmental circumstances this time frame will be reduced. When the goods are intensively used or exposed to friction the recommended re-applying should be each 4-6 months.

When not intensively used recommended re-application should be 12 – 16 months.

Drying time: After approx.20-30 minutes, depending on temperature and surface porosity. The complete drying process and effectiveness of the impregnation will take approx. 24 hours. Do not stain with oil or water during the drying step.

Coverage: Depends on the application method, coating thickness, and absorbency of the substrate. The coverage with the brush method is approx. 2 m²- 10m2/litre.

Stay Dry nano coating spray is suitable for: Fleece, mesh fabric, windproof, soft shell, Gore-tex® and eVent® linings, satin, linen, cotton, leather, suede, canvas, polyester, nylon, wool, silk, synthetic blends, microfiber, denim, futurelight

Weight: 0.285 kg

Dimensions: 5 x 5 x 21 cm

Made in Estonia

data.name: Eco-friendly Shoe Cleaner Gel, 150ml
data.description:
GoGoNano Clean is an innovative, eco-friendly shoe cleaner gel for shoes, textiles, and suede. Our cleaning solution effectively removes tough dirt and stains from fabric and suede items without the need for machine washing. Made with vegan, plant-based ingredients, the powerful yet gentle eco cleaner is safe for your belongings and the environment.

  • Ideal for shoes, textiles, and suede
  • Gel formula for precise, easy hand cleaning
  • Vegan and plant-based ingredients
  • Safe for delicate materials and can be used as suede cleaner
  • Reduces reliance on machine washing for stain removal
  • 100% eco-friendly formula, PFC-free
  • Leaves items clean and fresh

GoGoNano Eco-Friendly Shoe Cleaner for Shoes and Textiles. Whenever you buy anything, you want it to last as long as possible. It can therefore be both frustrating and expensive when products made from materials like leather, suede or other textiles don’t last as long as you would expect. The best way to ensure your items, such as clothing and shoes, last a long time is by maintaining them properly – that includes cleaning them.

We understand that not all cleaning products are safe to use on all materials, which is why we designed Clean – a eco-friendly shoe cleaner gel that is both safe for you, the environment and for the materials you use it on. It utilizes the power of nanotechnology to provide a more intensive cleaning than other products on the market.

Cutting-Edge Cleaning Technology: The power of Clean shoe cleaner comes from a unique blend of biobased surfactants and natural co-solvents. Derived from fermentation technology, these ingredients create a powerful cleaning action that’s gentle on fabrics and the environment. The gel’s nanostructure allows for deep penetration into fibers, effectively lifting dirt and stains.

Key features of our eco-friendly cleaning technology include:

  • 100% biobased active ingredients for powerful, natural cleaning
  • Fermentation-derived components enhancing the cleaner’s effectiveness
  • Nanostructured gel allowing deep penetration into fabrics
  • Hypoallergenic formula suitable for users with sensitive skin

Versatile Cleaning for Multiple Materials: GoGoNano shoe cleaner simplifies cleaning routines across various materials. The formula effectively removes stains and dirt from shoes and textiles by hand, gently cleans suede, and reduces the need for frequent washing, helping preserve fabrics. It performs exceptionally well on various textiles, including those used in sportswear and outdoor gear.

Eco-Friendly Benefits:

Clean is not only effective but also environmentally responsible. Our textile cleaner eco-friendly features include:

  • Biodegradable formula minimizing environmental impact
  • Reduced water usage by limiting the need for machine washing
  • PFC-free composition aligning with eco-conscious values
  • Vegan ingredients ensuring no animal-derived components

How to Use GoGoNano Shoe Cleaner For best results:

On shoes and textiles: Apply the cleaner to a damp microfiber cloth or on shoe brush, then gently clean the surface.

On clothing: Use with a microfiber cloth for spot cleaning, reducing full washes.

On absorbent leather and suede: Avoid direct contact. Use minimal product with a microfiber cloth for gentle, effective cleaning. Not recommended for smooth leather.

Stubborn stains: Allow the cleaner to work for up to 30 minutes before wiping clean. Water can be used at any stage if needed.

Dimensions: 4 x 4 x 16 cm

Made in Estonia

Care: Wash in a washing machine with a capacity of 6 kg or more. Wash separately at a maximum temperature of 30ºC. Do not use bleach or fabric softeners. Avoid continuous exposure to the sun. Use a gentle wash program if the rug has braids or fringes. Use a low-power vacuum cleaner regularly to clean the carpet and prevent fibers from falling out. Tumble dry on low heat. Do not leave in washing machine. If you find a long thread, cut it with scissors. Never pull it. To remove stains, use lukewarm water and mild soap.

Vegan Fox is a small family business from Latvia. Buying Vegan Fox products, you are supporting Vegan Fox family to help as many animals as possible find a good home. The brand works closely with shelters to encourage people to adopt their little friends responsibly.
As thank-you gifts, the products go to the good people who make animals feel at home, who support animal rights, who fight against captive wildlife and who care. By buying Vegan Fox products, you are also lending a helping hand, because we can do even more good deeds for animals.

data.name: Natural Exfoliating Cleansing Gel with Bamboo, 125ml
data.description:
Discover the power of Natural exfoliating cleansing gel, crafted to effectively cleanse while maintaining a gentle touch. Enriched with bamboo particles, it exfoliates, softens, and refreshes, all while helping to balance sebum secretion. The bamboo particles work their magic without causing micro damage to the skin, and they are environmentally friendly too.

Natural exfoliating cleansing gel is perfect for daily use, effortlessly removing makeup, dirt, and grease. The bamboo particles work their magic by effectively and gently peeling away impurities. Aloe vera deeply soothes and moisturizes, leaving your skin feeling nourished. Sage extract and betaine contribute to a soft and balanced complexion by helping regulate sebum production. And with gentle herbal detergents, you won’t have to worry about dryness or irritation.

To enhance your cleansing experience, we’ve infused the gel with the invigorating scents of green tea and lemon essential oil, leaving you feeling energized and revitalized. And don’t forget, this cleansing gel contains only the good stuff! Let the goodness of nature bring a cheerful glow to your skincare routine!

Aloe vera has been used in folk medicine for centuries. It is an excellent skin moisturizer and soothing agent, making it perfect for relieving irritations and even sunburn. Aloe vera has a calming effect and delivers oxygen to the skin, leaving it silky and soft.

Betaine is derived from sugar beet and is a highly versatile ingredient that fits well in many products because it highlights their beneficial properties. It has excellent moisturizing effects and gives the skin a silky feel. Betaine has a calming effect and makes the skin soft and smooth. It is primarily used to boost hydration.

Organic sage extract is anti-inflammatory and antiseptic. It is excellent for combination/oily skin care products as it helps keep pores clean.

Take an appropriate amount of the product and apply it to moist fingers. Gently massage it onto your skin and then rinse off with water.

  • Gentle exfoliation

  • Removes makeup, dirt and grease

  • Softens and nourishes

  • Balances sebum secretion

  • No dryness or irritation

  • For everyday use

  • For all skin types

  • Certified ECOCERT/COSMOS Natural

  • The product is made in Estonia, and during its production, good manufacturing practices have been followed.

INCI: Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis, Coco-Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Betaine, Xanthan Gum, Salvia Officinalis Leaf Extract, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Powder, Citrus medica limonum (Lemon) Peel oil, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Parfum, Limonene

Natural origin: 98%
100% vegan

COSMOS ORGANIC certified by Ecocert Greenlife according to COSMOS Standard

data.name: Natural Floor Cleaner EcoFloor, 1L
data.description:
EcoFloor natural floor cleaner deep cleans and protects all hard floors. Its unique formula leaves behind a protective nano-coating that repels dirt and grime, making future cleaning easier and less frequent. Safe for all hard floor surfaces, including laminate, hardwood, varnished wood, vinyl, PVC, and tile.

  • Deep cleans and protects all hard floors (PVC, vinyl, tile, laminate, varnished wood)

  • Plant-based, natural floor cleaner

  • Streak-free shine and leaves an invisible protective layer

  • Formulated with non-ionic surfactants

  • Eco-friendly and safe for kids and pets

  • Easy to use, just dilute and mop

Instructions for Use:

Check whether your floor can be cleaned wet or slightly damp.

Add 5 caps (about 50ml or 1% concentration) of EcoFloor to 5 liters of water.

Increase dosage for heavily soiled floors.

Mop the floor with a microfiber mop or floor cloth.

Let the floor dry completely.

Store the product under normal conditions.

data.name: Elva Dog Carrier & Personal Bag - Light Grey
data.description:

It features two types of inserts for carrying pets and serving as a personal bag for everyday use. data.name: Harness With Leather – Travel
data.description:
The travel collection is a bull's-eye for all travel lovers. A colorful pattern depicting a plane crossing the most popular places around the world will catch the eye of every globetrotter. Products of the travel collection include, among others, the Eiffel Tower, the Statue of Liberty, the Egyptian Pyramids, the Warsaw's Mermaid, the Sagrada Familia and others!

The leather-accented product is specially designed for your four-legged friends, we’ve combined a very strong yet gentle polypropylene webbing with genuine leather, into which the clasp is sewn. This is real, soft, and durable leather, the same type used in high-quality horse saddles.

The harness fits your pet perfectly and won’t irritate their skin. The top buckle adds convenience and comfort, while two durable plastic adjusters allow for a precise fit to your dog’s body.

One of the key advantages of the product is how quick and easy it is to put on — simply slip the smaller opening over the head, fasten the larger one just behind the front legs, and you're ready to go!

Cliff is a backpack from NOEL, an Estonian bag brand, behind which is the team of Matrix Pro, the manufacturer of professional hiking backpacks. Cliff is inspired by the long history of Matrix Pro’s hiking backpack production but is primarily designed for the street. But, of course, it handles shorter hikes or trips well too. The bag’s capacity is 25 liters and the inner walls have a padded laptop pocket that can accommodate a laptop up to 17 inches. In addition, there are several smaller pockets inside the bag, one of which is zippered. The bag has a large front pocket, which also contains one zippered pocket and two open pockets. The bag is made of durable Cordura material and is waterproof. This bag will serve you long and well – whether you take it to the office, on a hike, or to the gym.

Behind the NOEL brand are the creators of Matrix Pro, a professional hiking backpack manufacturer. In the category of hiking backpacks, Matrix Pro is the absolute world-class – even Estonian mountaineers Alar Sikk and Andras Kaasik trust Matrix Pro bags. Now you can carry this quality on the streets as well. All NOEL bags are handmade in Tartu.

  • Made of Durable Cordura

  • Dimensions: 15 x 30 x 59 cm

  • Capacity: 25 liters

  • 100% Estonian handcraft

data.name: Pot holder "Kitchen"
data.description:
Enhancing classical painting techniques with elements of pop art, kitsch, and camp, Katrin Valgemäe’s subtly grotesque pinup product series takes inspiration from the media’s exaggerated self-centeredness, revealing various layers with intriguing narratives upon closer examination.

The idea for this painting came from the artists own life. “It is my allegorical self-portrait. The kitchen is the epicentre of my home. It’s a place where I spend most of my time. Whether it is caring for my small child, cooking, or doing other chores, everything happens in the kitchen. I also paint in the kitchen. Additionally, there is a hint of influence from Richard Hamilton, from his (1956) collage “Just what is it that makes today’s homes so different, so appealing?” I tried to capture the satire of my “well” organised everyday life, the parodical stretch of the overwhelming illusion – always trying to be everything to everybody and nothing less.”

  • The pot holder is handmade in Estonia
  • Upper side: 100% polyester
  • The other side is a 50/50 blend of cotton and polyester
  • Wash at 40 degrees
  • Size: 20 x 20 cm
  • The price includes one pot holder

data.name: MeowBaby® Plywood Kitchen Helper Scandi - Gray
data.description:
MeowBaby® Kitchen Helper Scandi will enable your child safely and easily reach the kitchen counter. The three-stage height adjustment means that this piece of furniture may stay in your kitchen for many years. The highest platform can be used by toddlers who have just learned how stand on their own, while the lowest level is suitable for older children until they grow out of it.

The kitchen helper guarantees mutual joy in everyday activities. Now you don’t need to move a chair to the counter or sit your child on the table anymore! Make sure that your child is safe while cooking together and strengthen their sense of independence.

This stable kitchen helper is made of a moisture-resistant and abrasion-resistant birch plywood covered on both sides with a melamine coating.

The simplicity of white smooth sides and visible wooden edges remind you of Scandinavian minimalism.

Information:

  • Material: birch plywood: sides covered with melamine, oiled edges
  • Adjustable platform (20 cm – 30 cm – 40 cm, measured from the floor level), in order to adjust the height of the platform to the height of your child, you only need to put the platform onto the chosen level
  •  Dimensions:
    • overall height: 90 cm
    • width: 39 cm
    • depth to the step: 52 cm
    • thickness of the plate: 1.6 cm
  • Made in Poland

data.name: Cotton Kitchen for Kids
data.description:
A fully handmade textile toy stove that is also a storage basket.

The kitchen is the heart of every home, a source of tradition, a meeting place for the whole family and a natural playground for improving culinary skills. In the Little Chefs collection, storage baskets have become something more. They have been transformed into interactive, textile toys that will transport you to a vintage kitchen from the 60s.

It is made using artisan techniques, using braided cotton strings mixed with fibers from recycled PET bottles and cotton canvas in the dominant color Blue Sage. 

Much more than a basket, this play kitchen comes with a textile cooking pot — made with RugCycled® strings  —  and a padded, child-sized cotton oven mitt. The front features a rectangular oven door and a cotton canvas control panel with five knobs. The cooktop features embroidered strings to imitate a traditional gas stove. The stove is finished in a muted sage blue with Pearl Grey and Dark Grey details, and is individually packaged in a cardboard box. Its delicately handcrafted details make each play kitchen unique and essential for stimulating children's imaginations in true Montessori style. 

  • Size: 30 x 33 x 26 cm

  • Composition: 72% polyester fibers from recycled PET bottles; 28% cotton

  • Color: Grey

  • Weight: 3.65kg

  • Certificates: European standard on Safety for toys, ASTM F963-17, American Standard Consumer Safety Specification on Toy Safety

data.description:
A practical floor mat that looks good in your home. Protects your floors from food, spills, and creative messes. Made from soft, durable vegan leather with a non-slip bottom so it stays in place during mealtime chaos or craft time experiments.

  • Non-toxic and child-safe

  • Waterproof and wipeable

  • For floors, tables, picnic setups, craft corners, and more

Cleaning and care

  • Machine washable at 30°C

  • Avoid harsh or alcohol-based cleaners

  • Not cut-proof

Color may vary slightly depending on lighting.

data.name: LUULA Acrylic Board - School Planner
data.description:
The LUULA school planner is a clear and practical tool to help children take charge of their routines, homework, and weekly plans. Designed to encourage independence and a sense of responsibility, it gives kids a simple visual way to track what’s coming up—without the clutter of stickers, magnets, or apps.

Made from 0.5 cm thick transparent acrylic, the board is laser-cut with smooth, rounded edges and a polished finish. It’s easy to write on and clean, works with dry-erase or chalk markers, and is built to handle everyday use.

The clean, minimal design blends into any space—from a homework corner to a shared kitchen wall—and makes routines visible without being overwhelming. Whether it’s a reminder for tomorrow’s gym class or keeping track of reading assignments, this planner helps reduce stress and decision fatigue for both kids and parents.

It comes with a set of distancers, which create a slight gap between the board and the wall or stand. This makes writing and wiping easier, and gives the planner a light, floating appearance.

  • Package includes: 1 whiteboard, 4 distancers – for clean “floating” installation on wall or stand.

  • 5 mm thick transparent acrylic

  • Smooth, scratch-resistant surface

  • Easy to clean – works with dry-erase or chalk markers

A beautiful, durable and functional piece your child will return to every day.

searchRow.name: Origami Nursery Mobile - Gold Dust
searchRow.description:
Everything really does revolve around the baby. This handmade nursery mobile is a soft, elegant decoration you can hang above a crib or in any cozy corner of the room. The gentle movement of the paper cranes and pompoms helps catch your baby’s eye, encouraging visual focus, calmness, and a bit of fun.

Made with thick, acid-free paper, natural wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, and tiny bells—it's part toy, part art. A breeze or a small touch sets it in motion, creating a peaceful atmosphere. It’s also a lovely piece to hang in a toddler's or even older child’s room, or a thoughtful gift for a new family.

  • Materials: acid-free paper, wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, bells

  • Handmade with care

  • Length: approx. 55 cm

  • Subtle, Scandinavian-inspired design

  • Works beautifully on its own or paired with garlands or wall hangings

  • Made in Poland

Originally designed as a personal project, the mobile has become a signature Moi Mili item. Let it spin.

Note: All Moi Mili products are handmade in small batches. Occasionally, a product may show as in stock but has just sold out — in that case, please allow 2–22 working days for production.

brand.name: moi mili
brand.description:
Moi Mili was born from its founder Klaudia’s passion for crafting and childhood imagination. What started with handmade toys and cushions for her son grew into a brand known for creating whimsical, practical, and durable decor for children’s rooms.
Inspired by her own childhood spent crafting with her grandfather and years of working with kids, Klaudia designs every product with creativity and care. All items are made locally in Poland in collaboration with trusted tailoring studios, using high-quality, eco-conscious materials sourced mainly from Europe.
Original designs, bold color combinations, and thoughtful details set Moi Mili apart. The brand values timeless aesthetics, imaginative play, and sustainability—turning children’s spaces into cozy, magical worlds. All Moi MIli items are made to order and can take 3-12 business days to make.

brand.name: Wooden Story
brand.description:
Wooden Story creates beautifully crafted wooden toys designed to inspire creativity and a love for nature. Made in Poland’s Beskidy Mountains from FSC-certified wood, each toy is free from harmful chemicals, finished with botanical oils, and colored with eco-certified dyes. 
Soft to the touch, with the natural scent of wood, they invite children into a world of imagination and play. Built to last for generations, Wooden Story toys are more than just playthings—they are a connection to nature, a lesson in sustainability, and a source of endless joy. 
Wooden Story offers a variety of wooden toys that stimulate the senses, are gentle to the touch, and exude the scent of the forest. Their range includes wooden blocks and educational puzzles inspired by the Montessori learning philosophy.

brand.name: Wooden Story
brand.description:
Wooden Story creates beautifully crafted wooden toys designed to inspire creativity and a love for nature. Made in Poland’s Beskidy Mountains from FSC-certified wood, each toy is free from harmful chemicals, finished with botanical oils, and colored with eco-certified dyes. 
Soft to the touch, with the natural scent of wood, they invite children into a world of imagination and play. Built to last for generations, Wooden Story toys are more than just playthings—they are a connection to nature, a lesson in sustainability, and a source of endless joy. 
Wooden Story offers a variety of wooden toys that stimulate the senses, are gentle to the touch, and exude the scent of the forest. Their range includes wooden blocks and educational puzzles inspired by the Montessori learning philosophy.

searchRow.name: Origami Nursery Mobile - White
searchRow.description:
Everything really does revolve around the baby. This handmade nursery mobile is a soft, elegant decoration you can hang above a crib or in any cozy corner of the room. The gentle movement of the paper cranes and pompoms helps catch your baby’s eye, encouraging visual focus, calmness, and a bit of fun.

Made with thick, acid-free paper, natural wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, and tiny bells—it's part toy, part art. A breeze or a small touch sets it in motion, creating a peaceful atmosphere. It’s also a lovely piece to hang in a toddler's or even older child’s room, or a thoughtful gift for a new family.

  • Materials: acid-free paper, wooden sticks, yarn pompoms, feathers, bells

  • Handmade with care

  • Length: approx. 55 cm

  • Subtle, Scandinavian-inspired design

  • Works beautifully on its own or paired with garlands or wall hangings

  • Made in Poland

Originally designed as a personal project, the mobile has become a signature Moi Mili item. Let it spin.

Note: All Moi Mili products are handmade in small batches. Occasionally, a product may show as in stock but has just sold out — in that case, please allow 2–22 working days for production.
